title: Search
description: Open search across everything in Nookly.

title: Quick open
description: Jump to a recent or pinned item by name.

title: Commands
description: Open the list of commands you can run.

title: Settings
description: Open or close this dialog.

title: Quick jot
description: Jot a thought down from anywhere. Refine it into a note later.

title: Jot for the current session
description: Open the jot of the session happening now, creating it first. Shows an error when no session is running.

title: New task
description: Open the New task dialog from anywhere, in the Space you are working in.

title: Quick assignment
description: Open the New assignment dialog from anywhere. During a session it starts in that session's course and links the assignment to the session.

title: Import
description: Open the import dialog. Inside a text field it stays with the editor, where it makes text italic.

title: Filter
description: Open the filter menu on a list.

title: Find in page
description: Search the page you are writing in, with replace.

title: Collapse or expand the sidebar
description: Hide or show the sidebar on the left.

title: Collapse or expand the details sidebar
description: Hide or show the sidebar with properties and relationships on the right.

title: Go back
description: Return to the previous view.

title: Go forward
description: Move on to the next view in your history.

title: Go back (arrow)
description: A second way to go back. Does nothing while you type in a field.

title: Go forward (arrow)
description: A second way to go forward. Does nothing while you type in a field.

title: New tab
description: Open a new tab.

title: Close tab
description: Close the current tab.

title: Close other tabs
description: Close every tab except the current one. Pinned tabs stay.

title: Next tab
description: Switch to the tab on the right.

title: Previous tab
description: Switch to the tab on the left.

title: Next tab (alternative)
description: A second way to switch to the tab on the right.

title: Previous tab (alternative)
description: A second way to switch to the tab on the left.

title: Previous Space
description: Switch the sidebar to the Space before this one.

title: Next Space
description: Switch the sidebar to the Space after this one.

title: Split right
description: Open the current tab again in a group on the right, side by side.

title: Split left
description: Open the current tab again in a group on the left, side by side.

title: Focus the left group
description: Move to the tabs on the left while the view is split.

title: Focus the right group
description: Move to the tabs on the right while the view is split.

title: Zoom the focused group
description: Hide the other group so this one fills the page, or show both again.

title: Create
description: Create a new item in the list or calendar you are on.

title: Create (alternative)
description: A second way to create a new item in the list or calendar you are on.

title: Next task
description: Open the task below the current one in the list.

title: Previous task
description: Open the task above the current one in the list.

title: Go to today
description: Jump the calendar to today.

title: Previous period
description: Move the calendar back by a day, week or month, depending on the view.

title: Next period
description: Move the calendar forward by a day, week or month, depending on the view.

title: Write cards
description: Start writing new cards in the deck you have open.

title: Study the deck
description: Start a study session for the deck you have open.

title: Day view
description: Show the calendar as a single day.

title: Work week view
description: Show the calendar as a work week, Monday to Friday.

title: Week view
description: Show the calendar as a full week.

title: Month view
description: Show the calendar as a month.

title: Theme
description: Light, dark, or follow the system.

title: File viewer theme
description: How files are drawn in the viewer. Defaults draws code, text and markdown dark and documents light.

title: Your name
description: What the Dashboard greeting calls you. Leave it empty to be greeted without a name.

title: Server
description: The sync server this device signs in to. Nookly's own until you change it, or point it at one you host, like https://sync.example.com. Sync is optional; without an account everything stays on this device. Sign out to change it.

title: Time zone
description: The zone times are shown in. System follows your computer.

title: Date format
description: American (month first), European (day first), or the time zone's own.

title: Time format
description: American (12 hour), European (24 hour), or the time zone's own.

title: Effort scale
description: Show task effort as T-shirt sizes or points. Stored estimates never change.

title: Backup folder
description: The folder backups are written to.

title: Back up every day
description: Back up automatically once a day while Nookly is open. Keeps the newest 10 backups.

title: Default code language
description: The language a new code block starts with, used for syntax highlighting. A note can pick its own.

title: Session length
description: How long a new session is when you click an empty slot or press New. Dragging on the calendar still sets its own length. In minutes, 5 to 720.

title: Calendar entry length
description: How long a new calendar entry is when you click an empty slot or press New. Dragging on the calendar still sets its own length. In minutes, 5 to 720.

title: First day of the week
description: Where weeks begin in calendars, date pickers and week groupings. Automatic follows the date format: American starts on Sunday, the rest on Monday.

title: Day starts at
description: The hour the day and week views scroll to when they open. The whole day stays available. 0 to 23.

title: Current day colour
description: The colour that marks today in the week, day and month views. Primary is the app's blue, Neutral a quiet grey.

title: Current day intensity
description: How strongly today's column is tinted in the week and day views.

title: Snap to
description: How finely dragging snaps on the calendar when you create, move or resize something.

title: Format code when pasted
description: Tidies the code in a code block right after you paste into it, for the languages that have a formatter. Undo reverts it.

title: LaTeX macros
description: Your own LaTeX commands, for every math block and inline formula in every Space. It starts with a few common ones, like \abs and \norm.

title: Vim keys in pages
description: Edit pages with Vim's modes and keys: normal, insert and visual mode, motions like w and $, operators like d, c and y with text objects, counts, u to undo. Press ? in normal mode for the list. Off, the editor behaves as usual.

title: Check spelling
description: Underline misspelled words while you write in pages, and offer corrections on a right click. Nothing is checked while this is off. Code, links and mentions are never checked.

title: Spelling languages
description: The languages words are checked in. A word is right when it is right in any of them, so a page that mixes languages is checked as it is, without switching anything.

title: Turn arrows into symbols
description: Typing -> gives →, <= gives ≤, != gives ≠ and so on, outside code. Turn off to keep exactly what you type.

title: Page font
description: The typeface pages are written in. Default is the app's own, Serif is easier on long reading, Mono suits notes full of code.

title: Page text size
description: How large the text of a page is, in pixels. Headings grow and shrink with it. The default is 14.
